'''Csaus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Csaus system/Legends|Csaus system]] in the core territory of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was home of the [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]], one of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]]. Like other [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] of Ruling Families, Csaus was located on the [[Path of the Houses]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran through the Ascendancy. The planet was the Ascendancy's hub of sciences and communications.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Csaus was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
